_comment: Ground-truth intent for the reference lab in docker/lab/docker-compose.lab.yml. 'address' + 'open_ports' is what we deliberately exposed; the harness re-confirms each port with its own independent socket prober at run time and fails if intent and reality disagree. 'expected_service' is a substring the scanner's version string should contain. 'expected_vuln_flags' are NSE http-vuln-* scripts that should fire against the deliberately vulnerable host. This file must stay in sync with the compose file (test_differential.py asserts the address/port pairs match).

hosts.name: clean-web
hosts.note: Hardened nginx: all security headers present, only GET/HEAD. Should grade well and show no missing-header or dangerous-method deductions.

hosts.name: apache-vuln
hosts.note: Apache 2.4.49 in the exploitable config for CVE-2021-41773. The live NSE script should confirm the traversal/RCE.

hosts.name: redis-open
hosts.note: Unauthenticated Redis. High-risk open data store.

hosts.name: mongo-open
hosts.note: No-auth MongoDB. High-risk open data store.
